newsitem.title: USA: Connecticut Energy files for offering.
newsitem.headline: Connecticut Energy files for offering.

text.p: Connecticut Energy Corp said on Wednesday that it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed offering covering 1,750,000 shares of its common stock.

Proceeds from the offering will be contributed primarily to the company's principal subsidiary, The Southern Connecticut Gas Co and used to reduce short-term debt incurred at the unit under a capital spending program, Connecticut Energy said.
The company said it may also use a portion of the proceeds for other corporate purposes.
As of the end of the company's first quarter ended December, Connecticut Energy had about nine million shares of common stock outstanding.
